Implemented the `httpx` 0.26 proxy keyword update in [telegram/request/_httpxrequest.py](/app/telegram/request/_httpxrequest.py:169).

`HTTPXRequest` now stores the modern `proxy` kwarg and adapts to `proxies` only when the active `httpx.AsyncClient` or test double does not support `proxy`. This avoids the 0.26 deprecation and remains compatible with older fixed-signature test doubles.
